name: Sara Kararieva
original_name: サラ・カラリエーヴァ
source:
Born in the United States to a Japanese father and a Russian mother. She spent her childhood in the U.S., and recently came to Japan when her mother remarried. But she can speak Japanese suspiciously well. She's been a prep school English teacher. She's a queen of sadism.

[translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1170]Getchu[/url]]
